decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing builds on the firm's existing drain housing and installation knowledge, allowing it to interpret results and improve the product.
Floor-level shower drainage is core to the firm's existing expertise and product families, so absorptive capacity is high.
Designer shower drainage leverages the firm's design-conscious drainage knowledge and established customer channels, supporting learning and retention.
The shower element with integrated slope extends the firm's shower drainage and installation knowledge, making early results interpretable and actionable.
Backflow-protected basement floor drains remain within the firm's floor drain and drainage technology base, so the firm can assimilate and improve from early results.
The air-admittance valve lies outside the firm's core drainage and shower installation knowledge, so the firm can hardly interpret early results or learn from them.
